WORK EXPERIENCE

Anaplan Model Builder |Atlas Systems

April 2025 – Present

ensure on-time delivery.

teams.

May 2022 – March 2024

Hands on experience in converting User Stories into Real time

Anaplan Models

item & formula optimization

users

resolution

multiple spoke models.



The model provides Actual Revenue, actual Quarterly P&L so that

company track their business by comparing with predicted

Implemented and managed bottom-up quota planning processes

using the Cascading method.

Dynamic Cell Access in UAT and production workspace.



Followed Application Lifecycle Management to manage

Development, Testing & Deployment of our models.

Defined User Roles and Access.

requirements.
